description: This file defines a Java interface 'Range' with generic type T, representing a range of values with methods to check positional relationships, inclusion, overlap, and to retrieve start and end values.

classes.name: Range
classes.description: A generic interface representing a range of values with methods for range comparisons and properties.

methods.name: after
methods.description: Checks if this range occurs after another range or value.

methods.name: before
methods.description: Checks if this range occurs before another range or value.

methods.name: end
methods.description: Returns the ending value of the range.

methods.name: includes
methods.description: Checks if this range includes another range or a specific value.

methods.name: isPoint
methods.description: Checks if the range is a point (start and end are equal).

methods.name: overlaps
methods.description: Checks if this range overlaps with another range.

methods.name: start
methods.description: Returns the starting value of the range.
